# Requirements Quality Checklist: Harvest Record Capture

**Purpose**: Reviewer assessment of requirement completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability across SPEC-013 and its approved design artifacts.
**Created**: 2026-10-26
**Feature**: [SPEC-013](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are all required Harvest facts and their associations—Field, ACTIVE Season, date, positive quantity, selected unit, actor, and server acceptance context—defined across the spec and data model? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, §FR-004–008]
- [x] CHK002 Are OWNER/WORKER creation rights, ADVISOR create denial, and ordinary Diary read visibility stated distinctly and consistently? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §FR-011]
- [x] CHK003 Are requirements for multiple independent Harvests and preservation of accepted records explicit, including the absence of edit, delete, void, and correction behavior? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, §FR-007]
- [x] CHK004 Are all required mobile states covered: loading, empty, validation, confirmed success, connectivity failure, authorization denial, conflict, and server error? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012–013, approved shape brief]
- [x] CHK005 Are the approved shape decisions for the active-Season Diary entry point, fixed Field/Season context, and return-to-Diary success feedback represented consistently in the planning requirements? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012, Plan, approved shape brief]
- [x] CHK006 Are the note-free minimum Harvest and all frozen exclusions explicit across the spec, data model, API contract, and mobile brief? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014–015]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 Is the required Season unambiguously constrained to the same authorized Business and Field and ACTIVE at first acceptance, with Field-only and DRAFT-Season records excluded? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK008 Are date-only semantics explicit, including no fabricated time, no device-timezone shift, Business-local future-date validation, and the planting-date equality boundary? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, §SC-008]
- [x] CHK009 Are positive quantity, maximum three fractional digits, required per-record unit, no conversion, and reject-without-rounding behavior stated without relying on UI-only validation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK010 Is the plan's 11-integer-digit technical quantity ceiling carried consistently into the request/response contract and data model, and clearly distinguished from an agronomic product limit? [Clarity, Plan Technical Context, Data Model, Harvest OpenAPI]
- [x] CHK011 Are the canonical unit values (`KG`, `METRIC_TONNE`) clearly mapped to farmer-facing kilogram and metric-tonne labels without implying a conversion? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, Data Model, Harvest OpenAPI]
- [x] CHK012 Is the identity of one logical create and the meaning of an exact retry clear enough to distinguish unchanged content from changed actor, payload, Field, or Season context? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, Data Model, Harvest OpenAPI]
- [x] CHK013 Is the DATE-only Diary ordering rule clear for mixed timed and date-only entries on the same Business-local day, including the tie-break order and lack of a Harvest time? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010–011, Diary Contract Extension]

## Requirement Consistency and Traceability

- [x] CHK014 Do the spec, plan, data model, and create contract agree on the required Season, active-state rule, and same-Business/same-Field boundary? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, Plan, Data Model, Harvest OpenAPI]
- [x] CHK015 Do the spec and plan consistently distinguish first acceptance (requires ACTIVE Season) from replay of an already accepted record if its Season later changes state? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, §FR-009, Data Model]
- [x] CHK016 Do the spec, plan, data model, and contract agree on server-derived Business scope, current authorization revalidation, and privacy-safe handling of missing or foreign resources? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, §FR-009, §FR-011, Harvest OpenAPI]
- [x] CHK017 Do the spec, plan, and API contract consistently describe first acceptance, exact replay, changed-identity conflict, and concurrent convergence without a separate generic idempotency platform? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, §FR-009, Plan, Harvest OpenAPI]
- [x] CHK018 Does the Diary extension preserve the canonical SPEC-006 Diary operation rather than defining a competing history endpoint or duplicating Harvest records? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, Data Model, Diary Contract Extension]
- [x] CHK019 Are default-off `includeHarvests`, the new client's opt-in, existing V1 behavior, existing V2 Expense cursor compatibility, and cursor filter binding aligned across plan and Diary contract guidance? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, Plan, Diary Contract Extension]
- [x] CHK020 Are Diary pagination requirements explicit about stable ordering and previously eligible records while remaining consistent with the existing keyset contract's non-snapshot behavior during concurrent insertions? [Consistency, Clarity, Spec §FR-011, §SC-006, Diary Contract Extension]
- [x] CHK021 Are exact quantity-string semantics consistent from submission through accepted response and Diary projection, without a binary-floating representation or a silently changed unit? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, Data Model, Harvest OpenAPI, Diary Contract Extension]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK022 Do SC-001–SC-008 describe objectively observable outcomes for valid creation, multiple records, retry, access control, offline behavior, Diary traversal, historical stability, and date boundaries? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001–008]
- [x] CHK023 Do the success criteria make clear that only a server-confirmed result counts as accepted and that an uncertain retry must reuse the same logical submission? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, §SC-003, §SC-005]
- [x] CHK024 Are the exact quantity limits and date equality/future boundaries reflected in measurable acceptance language rather than only in explanatory prose? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, §SC-008]

## Authorization, History, and Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK025 Are revoked membership, ADVISOR create attempts, cross-Business and cross-Field access, missing Season, and non-ACTIVE Season outcomes covered without exposing protected existence or content? [Coverage, Edge Cases, Spec §FR-001–002, §SC-004]
- [x] CHK026 Are actor, server acceptance time, farmer-entered date, quantity, unit, and original Field/Season associations distinguished and retained as separate historical facts? [Coverage, Spec §FR-004, §FR-007–009, §SC-007]
- [x] CHK027 Are empty Diary, retryable read failure, access denial, same-date page boundaries, and Field-versus-Season filtering all covered by requirements? [Coverage, User Story 2, Spec §FR-010–012, §SC-006]
- [x] CHK028 Does the approved mobile brief define accessible labels/states, touch-target expectations, scalable text, and clear feedback for every required interactive or asynchronous state? [Coverage, Non-Functional, Spec §FR-012, approved shape brief]
- [x] CHK029 Are offline-before-submit and uncertain-response requirements distinct, with no local acceptance/queue and a truthful exact-retry path while the active form remains available? [Coverage, Recovery, Spec §FR-009, §FR-013, §SC-003, §SC-005]
